component.name: Carosello
component.summary: A fast, minimalist image and video viewer for Linux

description.p: Carosello is a fast, minimalist image and video viewer for Linux. It opens images and videos from a directory, lets you navigate between files with keyboard shortcuts or gestures, and displays them with zoom and pan capabilities.
A few optional capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Open media libraries kept outside the usual folders: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/media:ro io.github.grigio.carosello

screenshot.caption: Carosello viewing images with navigation controls
